€1 P. To look at, see, behold. ━Caus. To show, indicate,
 exhibit; उत्कलादर्शितपथः

Not capable of being seen. epithet of परमेश्वर.
.━{@Comp.@}: अदृश्यकरणम्
+ -करणम् rendering invisible, a part of a conjurerʼs legerdemain.
Invisible, not seen; ˚पूर्व not seen before.
Not known or experienced, not felt; ˚विरहव्यथम्

Unforeseen, not observed or thought of; unknown, unobserved. तस्माददृष्टं
 त्वां भयमागमिष्यति

Not permitted or sanctioned, illegal; न चादृष्टां (वृद्धिं)
 पुनर्हरेत्
+ .{@-ष्टः@} N. of some venomous substance or vermin.

Destiny, fate, luck (good or bad); दैवमिति यदपि कथयसि पुरुषगुणः
 सोऽप्यदृष्टाख्यः

Virtue or vice as the eventual cause of pleasure or pain. (Fate is
 supposed to be the result of good or bad actions done in one state of existence
 and experienced in another, the performance of good deeds being rewarded
 with residence in Heaven, and of bad deeds, visited with condemnation
 to Hell; धर्माधर्मावदृष्टं स्यात् धर्मः स्वर्गादिसाधनम … अधर्मो
 नरकादीनां हेतुर्निन्दितकर्मजः Bhāṣā

-2. The Vedāntins do
 not recognize अदृष्ट or luck; तैर्हि कर्मणः सूक्ष्मावस्थापन्नसंस्कारविशेष
 एव अदृष्टस्थानीयत्वेनाङ्गीक्रियते; अदृष्ठम् आत्मधर्म

An unforeseen calamity or danger (such as from fire, water &c.)
.━{@Comp.@}: अदृष्टार्थ, अदृष्टकर्मन्, अदृष्टकल्पना, अदृष्टनरः, अदृष्टपुरुषः, अदृष्टफल, अदृष्टहन्

+ -अर्थ a. [ब˚] having a metaphysical or occult meaning,
 metaphysical; having an object not evident to the senses.

+ -कर्मन् a. one who has had no practice or practical experience,
 not practical, inexperienced; कर्मस्वदृष्टकर्मा यः शास्त्रज्ञोऽपि
 विमुह्यति

+ -कल्पना Supposition of an invisible object or idea. दृष्टे
 सत्यदृष्टकल्पनाऽन्याय्या

+ -नरः, -पुरुषः one of the 20 ways of peace-making, in which
 no third person is seen, said of a treaty concluded by the parties themselves
 without a mediator यत्र शत्रुः पणं कुर्यात्सोऽदृष्टपुरुषः स्मृतः

+ -नरः, -पुरुषः one of the 20 ways of peace-making, in which

 without a mediator यत्र शत्रुः पणं कुर्यात्सोऽदृष्टपुरुषः स्मृतः
An evil or malicious eye, evil look, an angry or envious look.
Not being seen. ━a. [न˚ ब˚] Blind, sightless.
To respect, honour, reverence; सीतां रघूत्तम भवत्स्थितिमाद्रियस्व

receive respectfully; take or receive respectfully; द्वितीयाद्रियते
 सदा H.
; सर्वे तस्यादृता धर्मा यस्यैते त्रय आदृताः
To heed or care for, mind, take notice of; usually with न; न त्यागमाद्रियते

; अनादृत्य
 disregarding; मम वचनमनादृत्य in spite of or notwithstanding my words.
to feel timid from a feeling of respect, be awed.

To apply or devote oneself closely to, have regard for; भूरि श्रुतं
 शाश्वतमाद्रियन्ते
To desire, be eager for; यत्किंचिद् दुर्मदाः स्वैरमाद्रियन्ते निरर्गलम्
To make accessible, bring to light, manifest.
